limitations_and_boundaries: The study does not provide in vivo evidence for the proposed model.
The experiments are primarily in cell lines (MCF10A, MII, MDA-MB-231) and may not fully recapitulate in vivo tissue contexts.

missed_core_items.description: The study uses a microdevice to apply stretching to epithelial monolayers and shows that stretching overcomes YAP/TAZ inhibition and growth arrest in contact-inhibited cells.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: we developed a microdevice that reproduces some of the mechanical challenges experienced by tissues, such as stretching (Figures 2A and S2A–S2C).

missed_core_items.description: The study reports that YAP/TAZ activity depends on formin-dependent F-actin bundles, as shown by inhibitor experiments.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: qPCR for CTGF indicated that YAP/TAZ activity mostly depends on F-actin bundles (Figure 3E).

missed_core_items.description: The study shows that depletion of CapZ does not decrease YAP phosphorylation, indicating that cytoskeletal regulation of YAP/TAZ is independent of Hippo-mediated phosphorylation.

missed_core_items.description: The study demonstrates that LATS1/2 depletion alone cannot rescue contact inhibition of proliferation in large fibronectin-coated islands, but combined depletion with CapZ fully rescues proliferation in the center.

missed_core_items.description: The study shows that 4SA-TAZ-expressing cells in stiff 3D ECM do not form tubular structures but invade as single cells, indicating unleashed TAZ activity.

research_questions.statement: How do mechanical forces regulate YAP/TAZ activity in multicellular contexts?

provenance.text_excerpt: LATS1/2 are effective inhibitors of YAP/TAZ only in the context of a mechanically competent F-actin cytoskeleton.

claims.statement: LATS-mediated inhibition of YAP/TAZ requires a mechanically competent F-actin cytoskeleton.

provenance.text_excerpt: Cytoskeletal Regulation of YAP/TAZ Dominates over Hippo Signaling

claims.statement: Cytoskeletal regulation of YAP/TAZ dominates over Hippo signaling.

provenance.text_excerpt: We identify the F-actin-capping/severing proteins Cofilin, CapZ, and Gelsolin as essential gatekeepers that limit YAP/TAZ activity in cells experiencing low mechanical stresses, including contact inhibition of proliferation.

claims.statement: F-actin-capping/severing proteins Cofilin, CapZ, and Gelsolin are essential gatekeepers that limit YAP/TAZ activity in cells experiencing low mechanical stresses.

provenance.text_excerpt: We propose that mechanical forces are overarching regulators of YAP/TAZ in multicellular contexts, setting responsiveness to Hippo, WNT, and GPCR signaling.

claims.statement: Mechanical forces are overarching regulators of YAP/TAZ in multicellular contexts, setting responsiveness to Hippo, WNT, and GPCR signaling.

provenance.text_excerpt: mechanical cues also dominate the cellular response to soluble cues positively affecting YAP and TAZ activity. We show that YAP/TAZ activation by WNT or GPCR signaling requires a mechanically stressed cytoskeleton or, in cells experiencing a soft ECM, inactivation of F-actin capping and severing proteins.

claims.statement: Mechanical cues dominate the cellular response to soluble cues (WNT, GPCR) positively affecting YAP/TAZ activity.

evidence_spans.content: Combined depletion of CapZ and LATS1/2 cooperated to fully induce nuclear localization of YAP and TAZ in cells seeded on soft hydrogels and dense conditions.

evidence_spans.content: Combined depletion of CapZ and LATS1/2 fully rescued the blockade of S phase entry in cells located at the center of the epithelial sheets, triggering unabated proliferation evenly throughout the island.

provenance.text_excerpt: combined depletion of CapZ and LATS1/2 fully rescued the blockade of S phase entry in cells located at the center of the epithelial sheets, triggering unabated proliferation evenly throughout the island (Figures 6I and S6F).

evidence_spans.content: Depletion of LATS1/2 could not rescue YAP/TAZ inhibition by a soft environment.

provenance.text_excerpt: depletion of LATS1/2 could not rescue YAP/TAZ inhibition by a soft environment (Figures 6C)

evidence_spans.content: Depletion of capping and severing proteins re-empowered YAP/TAZ activation by WNT and GPCR signaling on soft ECM.

provenance.text_excerpt: depletion of capping and severing proteins re-empowered YAP/TAZ activation by WNT and GPCR signaling (Figures 6K, 6L, and data not shown).

evidence_spans.content: Knockdown of APC caused robust upregulation of YAP/TAZ-dependent transcription on stiff substrates but minimal effect on soft matrix. TRAP6 operated only on stiff matrices.

provenance.text_excerpt: knockdown of APC (mimicking WNT signaling by inactivation of the APC/Axin/GSK3 TAZ destruction complex; Azzolin et al., 2012) caused robust upregulation of YAP/TAZ-dependent transcription in cells cultured on stiff substrates but had minimal effect in cells seeded on a soft matrix. Similarly, addition of TRAP6, a positive inducer of YAP/TAZ activity through GPCR signaling, could operate only in cells cultured on stiff but not soft matrices (Figure 6L).

experiments_or_tasks: Identification of F-actin-capping/severing proteins (Cofilin, CapZ, Gelsolin) as gatekeepers limiting YAP/TAZ activity under low mechanical stress.
Investigation of YAP/TAZ localization in response to mechanical stresses such as stretching, edge/curvature location, and ECM stiffness.

methods.name: Cell culture and transfection
methods.protocol_description: MCF10A and MII cells were used. siRNA transfections were performed with Lipofectamine RNAi-MAX. DNA transfections were done with TransitLT1. Cells were plated on fibronectin-coated hydrogels or micropatterned glass slides.

methods.name: Immunofluorescence and microscopy
methods.protocol_description: Cells were fixed and stained with anti-YAP/TAZ antibody. Nuclear localization was scored as nuclear (N), even (N/C), or cytoplasmic (C).

methods.name: Luciferase reporter assay
methods.protocol_description: 8XGTIIC-lux reporter was used to measure YAP/TAZ transcriptional activity.

methods.name: 3D culture assay
methods.protocol_description: Cells were embedded in Growth Factor Reduced Matrigel and Collagen I mixes. Colony size and morphology were assessed.

results.metric_name: YAP/TAZ activity after knockdown of F-actin-capping/severing proteins

provenance.text_excerpt: We next sustained endogenous YAP/TAZ activity in cells embedded in the soft ECM through siRNA-mediated knockdown of Cofilin or Gelsolin. Strikingly, this induced the formation of bigger acini and caused the appearance of elongated or branched structures (Figure 5C) and was paralleled by YAP/TAZ-dependent induction of CTGF and CYR61 mRNAs (Figure 5D).

results.value_raw_text: Depletion of Cofilin or Gelsolin in cells embedded in soft ECM induced formation of bigger acini and elongated/branched structures, with YAP/TAZ-dependent induction of CTGF and CYR61 mRNAs.
